content: वलित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Moving. .²2 Moved, turned round, bent round. .²3 Surrounded, enclosed; समवलोक्य तमोवलितं जनम् <ls>Veda-Vyāsāṣṭaka 1</ls>. .²4 Wrinkled; विशदभ्रूयुगच्छन्नवलितापाङ्गलोचनः <ls>Ki. 11. 4</ls>. .²5 Cast, darted; वलितलोलकटाक्षपराहतम् <ls>Māl. 8. 11</ls>. .{@-तः@} A particular position of the hands in dancing. .{@-तम्@} Black pepper.
